description:
In this episode of Bible Q&A Program: “I’d Like to Know”, Pastors Stephen Bohr, C.A. Murray, and David Salazar answer powerful questions about deliverance ministry, end-time buying and selling, and the symbolic woman in Revelation. 

Questions:

02:15 – Does deliverance ministry have a place in the church?
What does the Bible say about casting out demons and spiritual warfare? The pastors discuss the risks and rightful role of deliverance in the life of a believer.

14:12 – What does “buying and selling” mean in Revelation 13?
Is it symbolic or literal? How does this phrase relate to end-time economic control, the mark of the beast, and spiritual compromise?

20:42 – What do the moon and 12 stars on the woman’s head in Revelation represent?
The team explores Revelation 12 and explains the prophetic meaning of the woman, her adornments, and their connection to God’s true church.

📖 These timely questions lead to vital truths about the last days, spiritual deception, and the identity of God’s people.

📅 New episodes every Tuesday at 4 PM PT on SUMtv.

💬 Got a question? Drop it in the comments — it could be featured in a future episode!
